newsitem.title: HONG KONG: 25 dead, 30 missing in China building collapse - HKTV.
newsitem.headline: 25 dead, 30 missing in China building collapse - HKTV.

text.p: A hostel housing more than 2,000 workers in eastern China collapsed on Tuesday killing at least 25, injuring 27 and leaving more than 30 missing, Hong Kong TVB news said on Thursday.
Officials from Putian city in the eastern Chinese province Fujian was quoted on the television as saying rescue workers were continuing to search for survivors.
The building belonged to a Hong Kong-based electronic firm, TVB said.
Putian city official said it was not clear why the building collapsed.
The incident was the latest in a string of building collapses in China blamed on poor construction.
Last week a seven-storey building in southern Guangdong province collapsed killing eight people and injuring two.
